H3K27M: a web app where a student pastes a histone H3.3 protein sequence and checks whether it carries the H3 K27M mutation, by comparing position 28 with a built-in normal human histone H3.3 reference (K = normal, M = H3 K27M).
Plain JavaScript. No backend. No libraries.
UI designs are in the design/ folder. Use them as the visual reference (same layout, labels and style), rebuilt with plain HTML and CSS.
Build one ticket at a time. One script per file.
